entities.summary: Hamid Rahimi is a boxer from Afghanistan. He currently resides in Germany. In February 2012, he won the New World Boxing Union (WBU) Championship by defeating his Belarusian rival in Hamburg. Hamid Rahimi was a athletes & competitors from Kabul (b. 1983-09-12, Kabul). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
